environment.description: Celery worker running on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The task queue accepts messages from an SQS-backed API endpoint. The API allows authenticated users to submit resize jobs with arbitrary width/height parameters (1-65535). The image source URLs are pre-signed S3 URLs generated by the application. The C extension (libimgproc.so) is compiled without AddressSanitizer and uses uint32_t for buffer size calculations. No input sanitization middleware exists between the API and the Celery broker.

config.api_gateway: ALB with no request body inspection
config.authentication: Cognito JWT (any authenticated user can submit jobs)
